title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: Fantastic soundboard capture of an incendiary show featuring scorching Shakedown Street, Scarlet‑Begonias > Fire on the Mountain, and a powerhouse Truckin’ > The Other One closing.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about a blistering performance – a hot first set that kicks off with Shakedown Street, a second‑set opening of Scarlet‑Begonias into Fire on the Mountain, and an explosive closing stretch of Truckin’, The Other One, Stella Blue and Sugar Magnolia.  The board source is praised as “fantastic,” delivering crystal‑clear audio that lets the band’s high energy shine through.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic reviews (4★ and 5★) highlight a top‑tier performance and an excellent soundboard recording, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Board copy described as fantastic and crystal‑clear; no issues or dropouts reported.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
Truckin' > The Other One > Stella Blue > Sugar Magnolia
show_quality.setlist_flow: Hot opening first set, seamless transition into a wonderful Scarlet‑Begonias/Fire second‑set opener, and an especially energetic closing sequence that builds to a climactic finish.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass intro into The Other One literally shook the Garden, underscoring his powerful contribution.
